answer_key.1: A census of VizieR catalogue metadata for single tables with metadata-reachable columns for gas-phase abundance, stellar mass, and redshift together; not an MZR or metallicity measurement. It does not establish that each table carries adjudicated physical measurements.
answer_key.2: Semantic UCD tags and column-name variants.
answer_key.3: 178 three-axis candidates, minus 21 modifier-filter drops (19 redshift-axis and 2 abundance-axis), leaving 157. All 157 proceed to T2. Separately, a side diagnostic finds frozen-term-regex matches in 62 of the 157 descriptions; 62 is not the T2 input subset.
answer_key.4: 62 is description-level gas-phase vocabulary presence from a deterministic term check; it is not an eligible-table count or scientific ruling.
answer_key.5: The pinned retrieval instrument returned all seven recall members and admitted none of three controls, supporting retrieval performance for that frozen set.
answer_key.6: Precision against the dominant contamination mode; the 7/7 and 0/3 checks validate the frozen retrieval instrument but do not certify precision.
answer_key.7: Symbol/meaning collisions: Galactic Cartesian height and stellar-grid metal fraction/model Z. Target-domain mismatches for galaxy-MZR work: stellar gravitational redshift and gravitational-redshift velocity. These are recorded examples, not T2 rulings.
answer_key.8: Reportable: T1 single-table retrieval counts, filter accounting, description-term side-check count, retrieval checks, and recorded precision-contamination examples. Cross-table joins/crossmatches were not assessed. Pending: the 157-table T2 eligibility application, eligible-table count, MZR measurement, and scientific interpretation.
